name: Mailcow
description: Complete mail server: SMTP/IMAP with Dovecot & Postfix, webmail (SOGo), spam filtering (Rspamd), DKIM — all managed from a polished web UI.
compose:
services:
  mailcow:
    image: ghcr.io/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      MAILCOW_HOSTNAME: "${{cfg.hostname}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/mailcow
    restart: unless-stopped
